title: New York's Eleven Madison Park has become the first vegan (素…

sents.en: New York's Eleven Madison Park has become the first vegan (素食主义的) restaurant to be awarded three Michelin stars.
sents.cn: 纽约的"十一麦迪逊公园"（ElevenMadisonPark）已成为首家获得米其林三星的素食餐厅。

sents.en: The fine dining establishment received its first three-star Michelin rating in 2011 when the menu was famed for its fancy animal-based dishes.
sents.cn: 这家高级餐厅在2011年首次获得米其林三星评级，当时其菜单以精致的荤菜闻名。

sents.en: However, last year, the restaurant's co-owner and famous chef, Daniel Humm, made the bold decision to remove meat from the menu, citing our unsustainable food system.
sents.cn: 然而，去年，餐厅的联合老板、名厨丹尼尔∙韩姆（DanielHumm）做出了一个大胆决定：以我们的食物系统不可持续为由，将肉类从菜单中移除。

sents.en: While cow milk is still served for tea and coffee, the menu is almost 100 percent vegan.
sents.cn: 尽管茶和咖啡中仍供应牛奶，但这份菜单几乎是100%纯素。

sents.en: At the time, Humm acknowledged the move was risky, admitting that ·it wasn't clear if guests would come·, but called the gamble ·a risk worth taking.·
sents.cn: 当时，韩姆承认这一举动有风险，他坦言"并不清楚是否还会有客人光临"，但却称这个赌注"值得一搏"。

sents.en: ·In view of the climate crisis, I didn't want to open the same restaurant,· Humm told the Financial Times in an interview.
sents.cn: "考虑到气候危机，我不想开一家同样的餐厅，"韩姆在接受《金融时报》采访时说。"如果我们能在此情境中展示出吃植物性饮食的可能性，就能为其他人跟进打开许多扇门。

sents.en: ·If we can show the possibilities of eating plant-based food in this setting, it can open a lot of doors· for others to follow.

Now, this impressive new accomplishment validates Eleven Madison Park's decision to take meat off the menu and embrace plant-based foods, with Michelin's 2022 New York guide branding it a ·bold vision of luxury dining·.
sents.cn: 如今，这一令人瞩目的新成就证实了"十一麦迪逊公园"将肉类撤下菜单、拥抱植物性食品的决定，米其林2022年纽约指南将其誉为"奢华餐饮的大胆愿景"。

sents.en: ·We took the jump to transform Eleven Madison Park into a plant-based fine dining restaurant knowing in our hearts this is what we believed in,· stated Humm on Instagram.
sents.cn: "我们下定决心，将'十一麦迪逊公园'转型为一家植物性高级餐厅，因为我们打心底里相信这就是我们所认同的，"韩姆在Instagram上表示。"昨晚，我们很荣幸连续第11年获得米其林三星。

sents.en: ·Last night, we were honored to be awarded three Michelin stars for the 11th year in a row.
sents.cn: 我无比感激在近25年历史中做出贡献的团队成员。

sents.en: I am so grateful to the team members who contributed through its nearly 25-year history.
sents.cn: 我们也感谢那些相信我们的愿景、并鼓励我们更加努力的客人与合作伙伴。

sents.en: We are also grateful to our guests and partners who believed in our vision and encouraged us to push harder.·
Three Michelin stars is the highest award, given to chefs who are at the peak of their profession.
sents.cn: 米其林三星是最高荣誉，授予处于职业巅峰的厨师。

sents.en: ·Their cooking is elevated to an art form and some of their dishes are destined to become classics,· reads Michelin's website, in a clear nod to plant-based foods' growing significance in the culinary (烹饪的) world.
sents.cn: 米其林官网写道："他们的烹饪被提升为一种艺术形式，其中一些菜品注定会成为经典，"这明确表明了植物性食品在烹饪界日益增长的重要性。

sents.en: ·I think luxury companies have a real role to play and a responsibility,· says Humm.
sents.cn: "我认为，奢侈品公司确实可以发挥作用，也肩负着责任，"韩姆说。"我们越有创意，我们的未来就会越美好、越美味。

sents.en: · The more creative we are, the more beautiful and delicious our future will be.·
